activity_summary: At the porch your mother said, once, that it was good you came at Lent and not only wrote it. You answered with the letter and the coming. She said she would not say it twice. Anne sent you both on after the children. No second sentence was added.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Answered with Friday's letter, and gave his arm.

entities.name: Mary Shakespeare
entities.context: Said the sentence once, and said she had finished.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Put them on the lane, and kept dinner from becoming a speech.

quotes.speaker: mary_shakespeare
quotes.text: It is good you came at Lent and not only wrote it.

quotes.speaker: mary_shakespeare
quotes.text: I have said the one thing. I will not say it twice.
